description.value: Qualicum Beach Bakery and Cafe is a European-style specialty bakery on West 2nd Avenue in Qualicum Beach, hand-baking breads, pastries, cookies, cakes, and pies fresh daily. The cafe side rounds out the offering with hot soups and a breakfast-and-lunch menu, making it a natural resupply stop for cyclists passing through town. The business presents itself as a local, independent operation with a focus on fresh and traditional baking.
